ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #13
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Surah:? (1 mark)
   A. Say Selected Surah: has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Surah:.
   C. Use Selected Surah: to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Selected Surah: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Nullifiers of Swalah? (1 mark)
   A. Use Nullifiers of Swalah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Nullifiers of Swalah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Nullifiers of Swalah.
   D. Say Nullifiers of Swalah has no place in daily life.

3. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Spreading rumours
   B. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   C. Cheating in exams
   D. Hiding stolen items

4. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on Gratitude? (1 mark)
   A. Use Hadith on Gratitude to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Hadith on Gratitude with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on Gratitude.
   D. Say Hadith on Gratitude has no place in daily life.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Sunnah Prayers Qabliyah and Ba'diyah? (1 mark)
   A. Say Sunnah Prayers Qabliyah and Ba'diyah has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Sunnah Prayers Qabliyah and Ba'diyah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Sunnah Prayers Qabliyah and Ba'diyah.
   D. Apply the teaching of Sunnah Prayers Qabliyah and Ba'diyah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on Greetings? (1 mark)
   A. Use Hadith on Greetings to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on Greetings.
   C. Say Hadith on Greetings has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Hadith on Greetings with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on good Behaviour? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on good Behaviour.
   B. Use Hadith on good Behaviour to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Hadith on good Behaviour has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Hadith on good Behaviour with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in Angels 3.2.1 Characteristics of angels? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Belief in Angels 3.2.1 Characteristics of angels.
   B. Use Belief in Angels 3.2.1 Characteristics of angels to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Belief in Angels 3.2.1 Characteristics of angels with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Belief in Angels 3.2.1 Characteristics of angels has no place in daily life.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in Prophets 3.3.1 Qualities of Prophets? (1 mark)
   A. Say Belief in Prophets 3.3.1 Qualities of Prophets has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Belief in Prophets 3.3.1 Qualities of Prophets.
   C. Use Belief in Prophets 3.3.1 Qualities of Prophets to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Belief in Prophets 3.3.1 Qualities of Prophets with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Taraweeh and Witr? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Taraweeh and Witr.
   B. Apply the teaching of Taraweeh and Witr with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Taraweeh and Witr to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Taraweeh and Witr has no place in daily life.

11. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Waste food daily
   B. Pollute rivers deliberately
   C. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   D. Destroy trees without planting

12. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on Knowledge? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Hadith on Knowledge with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Hadith on Knowledge to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on Knowledge.
   D. Say Hadith on Knowledge has no place in daily life.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Rights of Neighbours and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Islamic Rules on Buying and Selling and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Al-Isra wal Miraj 03 7.2 Pledges of Aqabah 03 7.3 Hijra to Madina 03 7.4 Constit and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Al-Isra wal Miraj and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
